raw_multikeyframe.confirmed_false_positive: clean_29 wood grain misclassified as floor_stain

reasons: Suppressed the real singleton drywall-patch detection at confidence 0.80.
Incorrectly merged a false water-droplet observation with the real bathtub crack.
Confidence alone is unsafe: the false bathtub droplet had confidence 0.95.
Bounding-box continuity is unreliable under handheld camera viewpoint changes.

key_learning: Multi-keyframe analysis improves verified development recall from 2/9 to 3/9.
Additional temporal coverage also increases false-positive opportunity.
Static heuristic consensus cannot reliably distinguish real singleton defects from hallucinated singleton findings.
Candidate verification should examine nearby temporal evidence directly.

next_candidate.name: detector_v3_temporal_verification_v1
design: For each candidate, review nearby frames with a conservative vision verification pass.
Verify the exact described condition, not merely a related condition in the same area.
Reject unsupported one-frame hallucinations such as the bathtub droplet and wood-grain stain.
Preserve real singleton defects such as the drywall patch when nearby visual evidence supports the same physical condition.
